name: Bulk Delete Comments
author: Shah Alom

sections.description: Allows to delete all comments with single click. you can select all unapproved and pending comments or comments based on category / post.
sections.installation:
Just a standard installation required.

  1. Plugins > Add New > Upload > ‘bulk-delete-comments.zip’ – Install Now

  2. Unzip & Upload ‘bulk-delete-comments.zip’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory

  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Does this plugin backups the comments in any other table ?

No, it does not.
